Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

To both parties: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02757 (EV-FARE-02757: cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is refunded to the rider in full.

How to appeal: POL-GEN-04. Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 4.50 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Rider advocate12 claim(s), 12 kept

  1. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and its limb (a) fails on the face of the record: the trip_record carries no driver 'arrived' event at all.

    Read the whole claim

    arrived_at is null and the event list holds only driver_assigned, driver_en_route and trip_cancelled. A no-show fee cannot be charged where the platform's own telemetry never records the arrival that limb (a) requires, and breaking this single limb is enough to defeat the charge.

    EV-TRIP-02757 · POL-NS-01

  2. Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 fails as well.

    Read the whole claim

    The trip is recorded under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CANCELLED with cancelled_by RIDER — not RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT — and it was terminated by the rider, not by the driver. Limb (d) requires the driver's termination on one of those three codes at or after the required dwell; none of that is present, so the fee is not chargeable under the anchor clause.

    EV-TRIP-02757 · POL-NS-01

  3. POL-NS-02 puts the driver nowhere near the pickup point.

    Read the whole claim

    Across 49 fixes his nearest approach to the pin was 7,000.01 m and his farthest 15,000.05 m, and the trace yields 0 qualifying in-radius fixes — the arrival radius for this STANDARD zone class being 50 m. With no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes preceding cancellation, the driver never arrived, limb (b) of POL-NS-01 fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

    EV-GPS-02757, EV-TRIP-02757 · POL-NS-02, POL-NS-01

  4. POL-NS-03 cannot rescue the fee either.

    Read the whole claim

    Its whole test is a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pickup pin. The closest this driver came was 7,000.01 m — more than seventeen times that ceiling — so this is not a wrong-entrance or wrong-block case, no fault allocation arises and no pin-ambiguity goodwill is engaged.

    EV-GPS-02757, EV-TRIP-02757 · POL-NS-03

  5. POL-NS-10 is the clause that decides a fee the rider's own cancellation triggered, and its limb (f) exception applies squarely.

    Read the whole claim

    The rider cancelled at 21:44:13, 420 seconds after the 21:37:13 acceptance and so beyond the 180 second grace, but the chat log shows the driver asked her to cancel: MSG-02757-001, sent 21:41:13, reads 'sorry got a problem with the car, can you cancel on your side', and she answered 'ok cancelling' at 21:42:13. Where the record shows the driver asked the rider to cancel, limb (f) directs that the fee be refunded in full.

    EV-CHAT-02757, EV-TRIP-02757, EV-FARE-02757 · POL-NS-10

  6. POL-NS-06 is drafted as strict liability and the arithmetic is one-sided: the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip (platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a shortfall of 180 seconds.

    Read the whole claim

    On a shortfall the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages. The waiting period is the consideration the fee was paid for, and this driver never began to earn it.

    EV-GPS-02757, EV-TRIP-02757 · POL-NS-06

The absence costs the driver any excuse and costs the rider nothing.
